text: On Saturday, February 22, 2015, I made an appointment with the doctor to have my teeth filled and my teeth cleaned. I made the appointment through a lady who called to ask when the doctor was available (I called on February 19). The appointment was for Saturday, probably at 3 PM. When I arrived on Saturday (9-10 AM in the morning, the lady called to confirm that I had an appointment today, so I said okay). When I arrived at 3 PM, there were no customers and the doctor was not there. The lady told me to wait. I said okay, I waited for almost an hour. Then a lady doctor came in instead. Then she started working. I asked the doctor, "Last year, I had a filling, why did it fall out so easily?" (Filled for about 1 year) The dentist said the filling would last about 1 year (I saw on another page that it said at least 3-5 years, which might be true or not, so I asked the dentist). This time, the front tooth that was filled from February 22, 2025 to May 8, 2025, should be a little over 3 months, the tooth that was filled has fallen out. The last time I filled my tooth + scaling (used social security), it cost 3900 baht (I probably filled 1-2 teeth, I’m not sure). To be honest, I’m very dissatisfied. I’d rather find another dentist (I got braces from a male doctor here. He has a gentle hand and speaks politely. I’ve been getting my teeth done here for many years). At first, I let it go, but the filling fell out after 3 months (the second time). The first time, I filled it for more than a year and it fell out. I really couldn’t take it anymore.
